primaryMetaphor: Luminous geometric sphere demonstrating positional and energetic states through vertical movement and color transformation
visualContinuity: Single sphere persists throughout, transforming position, color, and scale to embody the high/low concept

scenes.name: High State

keySync.visualEvent: Sphere reaches peak brightness and 80% height position with energy particle burst

scenes.visual: Large coral-colored sphere (#ff6b6b) materializes at center horizontally, 80% from bottom. Sphere glows with warm energy, emitting radial particles. Typography 'HIGH' appears at 85% height, centered horizontally, using 6% of canvas height font size. Sphere bounces with spring physics upon materialization, reaching full scale and brightness on the word sync.

scenes.name: Transition and Low State

keySync.visualEvent: Sphere settles at 20% height with gentle bounce, final color shift to cool blue complete

scenes.visual: Sphere transforms during descent from coral to cool blue (#667eea), moving from 80% height to 20% height with trailing particle effects. Scale reduces to 60% of original size. On 'and' (frame 52), sphere begins fluid gravitational fall. On 'low' (frame 55), sphere reaches final position with subtle settle bounce. Typography 'LOW' materializes at 15% height, centered, as sphere completes transformation.
scenes.buildsFrom: Sphere from high state begins descent transformation
